events.title: Public Speaking Workshop
events.description:
Speaker Workshop

Public Speaking Workshop

Join TEDxCMU for our first annual Speaking Workshop.

Learn about what makes a TED Talk shine, how to apply speaking insights to your everyday life, and build your talk-writing skills with us.

You’ll be able to hear from some of our previous student speakers, too!

When: September 27, 2026 • 5:00 PM

Where: DH 1212, Carnegie Mellon University

RSVP

Visual review: TEDxCMU public speaking workshop. The event date is confirmed as September 27, 2026. Official sources conflict on the time and venue: the homepage says 2:00 PM at Simmons Auditorium; the Events page says 5:00 PM at DH 1212; the linked public RSVP form says 3:00 PM at DH 1212. Time and venue require organizer confirmation. This record has date precision and does not assert an all-day event.

https://tartanconnect.cmu.edu/ical/teppe.strategy: Preserve the original public feed and import only the reviewed 2026-09-27 workshop date, guarded by the exact public announcement text. Withhold conflicting clocks and venues, preserve their source notes, and retain the organizer-confirmation flag. The 2027 main event remains Date TBA.
https://tartanconnect.cmu.edu/ical/teppe.reason: The workshop day is explicitly published, but the homepage, Events page and RSVP form disagree on clock/venue; date-only precision can be imported without choosing a conflicting field.

visualReview.note: New public RSVP form anonymously200 confirms2026SpeakingWorkshop Sept27 but says15:00 DH1212. Fresh homepage says14:00 Simmons; Events page says17:00 DH1212. Thus date/year are corroborated, but start/location remain conflicting.2027 main conference still DateTBA. Date-only import is supported by an exact public Events fragment; clocks and venue remain withheld pending organizer confirmation.

followupResolution.reason: Three publisher-controlled sources disagree on workshop time; two locations appear. No reliable precedence/update timestamp resolves it.
